problem_statement: website-templates/simple-gallery_responsive-template (the Underline Mural Archive) is a static, responsive photo gallery built with a Gulp/Pug/Stylus toolchain and served from a prebuilt build/ output. It has a blurred full-bleed landing (index.html) that links into a gallery.html page: a fixed brick-wall page header, then a responsive masonry card grid of eleven documented murals (each .gallery__isle card bound to a real photograph, a real Unsplash photographer, a mural title and a crew/artist credit) whose captions reveal on hover, and a footer credit. The archive now carries its own browsing control: a 'Filter murals by district' bar directly above the mural grid — a district tab row (All / Waterside / Railside / Industrial / Backstreet) that filters the eleven cards by their data-district (derived from each mural's real place-name) and shows a live count readout ('Showing N of 11 · <District>'); the same filter bar and a shared 'Districts we walk' rail also appear on a second curated route, collection.html ('The Archive by District'), so the browsing controls are consistent wherever a visitor lands. Four regressions must be repaired together: (1) RESPONSIVE — on a 390px phone the district tab row is a fixed-width no-wrap flex row that forces the whole page to scroll sideways; make it reflow within the viewport with no horizontal overflow. (2) CROSS-PAGE CONSISTENCY — the shared 'Districts we walk' rail must be present on the gallery filter AND on collection.html, not on the gallery alone. (3) VISUAL — the mural grid must lay its cards out cleanly (no overlapping or clipped cards), the active district tab must be legible, and the browse rail must keep the light archive palette (not a dark slab). (4) INTERACTION — clicking a district tab must actually filter the grid AND update the count readout to 'Showing N of 11 · <District>', not leave a frozen 'Showing all 11 murals'. The fix lives in the mural-filter stylesheet and script and the shared markup; do not alter the landing, the fixed page header, the mural photographs, their photographer credits, the hover captions or the footer.
required_content: The 'Filter murals by district' bar renders the five district tabs (All, Waterside, Railside, Industrial, Backstreet) and a live count readout above the eleven-card mural grid at every viewport.
On a 390px mobile viewport the gallery no longer scrolls horizontally: the district tab row reflows within the viewport (no horizontal overflow beyond a small tolerance).
The shared 'Districts we walk' rail appears on the gallery filter AND on the collection.html curated route, keeping the light archive palette (navy accents on white, not a dark slab).
The mural grid lays its cards out cleanly with no overlapping or clipped cards, and the selected district tab stays legible (readable label, clear active state).

Clicking a district tab filters the grid to the matching murals and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 11 · <District>' (e.g. 'Showing 3 of 11 · Railside'); it never leaves a stale 'Showing all 11 murals'.
The landing, the fixed page header, the eleven mural photographs and their real photographer credits, the hover captions and the footer remain intact and unchanged.
design_constraints: Preserve the Underline Mural Archive's design language: the blurred full-bleed landing, the fixed brick-wall page header, the light PT-Sans typography, the responsive masonry card grid, the navy hover caption overlay and the understated footer credit.
Keep the filter a single labelled 'Filter murals by district' bar above the mural grid; do not remove or reword the five district tabs or the count readout.
The shared 'Districts we walk' rail must appear on the gallery filter and on collection.html (consistent browsing controls), not on the gallery alone.

The district tab row must remain a horizontal row on desktop/tablet where space allows but must reflow within the viewport on narrow (mobile) widths rather than forcing sideways scrolling; do not mask overflow with overflow-x:hidden on the document or the row.

The district filter must genuinely filter the grid and keep the count readout in sync with the selected district on every click; keep every card bound to its existing photograph and real photographer credit.
state_constraints: desktop_initial captures the blurred full-bleed landing at 1440px whose centered wordmark reads 'Underline Mural Archive' with one link into the archive.
mobile_initial captures the same landing at 390px with no horizontal overflow.
tablet_initial captures the landing at 834px; the repair must not regress it.
desktop_gallery scrolls the 1440px gallery to the 'Filter murals by district' bar to confirm the tabs, count readout, the clean mural grid and the 'Districts we walk' rail render correctly.
mobile_gallery scrolls the 390px gallery to the filter bar, the location of the reported mobile overflow; the repair must close it while keeping the bar and rail.
desktop_gallery_grid scrolls the 1440px gallery grid into view to confirm the eleven mural cards lay out cleanly with no overlapping or clipped cards.
desktop_gallery_footer and mobile_gallery_footer scroll to the footer credit to confirm the untouched 'Underline Mural Archive' footer is preserved.
desktop_collection loads collection.html at 1440px to confirm the shared filter bar and the 'Districts we walk' rail are present on the second curated route.
mobile_collection loads collection.html at 390px to confirm the shared filter bar fits the mobile viewport.

desktop_filter_railside scrolls the 1440px gallery filter into view and clicks the 'Railside' district tab; the grid must filter to the three railside murals and the readout must read 'Showing 3 of 11 · Railside'.

change_completion: The 'Filter murals by district' bar renders the five district tabs and the count readout above the eleven-card mural grid at every viewport.
Clicking a district tab filters the grid and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 11 · <District>'; the shared 'Districts we walk' rail is present on the gallery filter and the collection.html route.
The landing, fixed page header, mural photographs, photographer credits and footer remain intact and reachable.
design_consistency: The repair preserves the archive's light PT-Sans palette, card rounding, navy hover captions and spacing across the filter bar, the mural grid and the browse rail.
The mural grid lays out cleanly with no overlapping/clipped cards and the active district tab stays legible.
responsive: 390px mobile gallery has no horizontal overflow at the district tab row or elsewhere.
834px tablet and 1440px desktop filter and grid layouts are preserved and continue to fit.
regression: The static gallery and collection routes still serve and render with zero remote requests and zero console errors.
The landing, fixed page header, mural photographs, photographer credits and footer are unchanged.

author_notes: True-new-L4 rebuild of the Underline Mural Archive gallery task (repo simple-gallery responsive-template). The native lever is the archive's own district FILTER (tab row + 'Showing N of 11 · <District>' count readout) above the eleven-card .gallery__flow mural grid, plus a shared 'Districts we walk' rail promoted onto a manufactured collection.html curated route. The graded diff is static/css/mural-filter.css + static/js/mural-filter.js + the shared filter/rail markup + gallery.html + collection.html; the landing, fixed page header, mural photographs, photographer credits and footer are untouched. Reference passes all four gates. Baseline reproduces a fixed-width no-wrap district tab row (mobile overflow ~382px) with the rail absent everywhere, but its filter wiring is correct so it PASSES the interaction gate. The smart-wrong bad narrows the tab row + adds overflow-x:hidden (still ~222px overflow), shingles the mural cards with negative margins, renders the active tab dark-on-dark and the rail as a dark-teal slab, and freezes the count readout so a district click never re-filters — failing all four gates while content/console/completion stay clean. The mural photographs (chris-barbalis, ckturistando, luis-vaz, ricardo-gomez-angel, scott-webb) and their photographer credits ground the gallery imagery.
